CallKeysParams.description:
The client timings and constants the server relays (READY `call_keys.params` and every
[`CallKeysInit`]; S50 §9.4, S51 §20.1). The single source for client timings.

ciphersuites.description: The ciphersuites the server accepts (`[1]` in v1).

client_activate_fallback_ms.description: A sender that acked but hears no `activate` switches after this long.

exporter_label.description: The MLS exporter label of frame keys ([`tls::EXPORTER_LABEL`]).

key_package_max_lifetime_s.description: Longest KeyPackage lifetime the server accepts.

retire_after_ms.description: Receivers retire an old slot this long after `activate`.

unknown_call_buffer_ms.description: Dispatches for a `call_id` the client does not know yet are buffered this long.

CallPublicKey.description: A public key and its id (`kid` = hex of the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw key).

VerificationCode.description:
Policy `calls.verification_code` (S50 §16.4): whether "Call info → Security code" is
shown. `required` is reserved for a later mode and refused by the policy validator.

oneOf.description: Shown on request, never modal (the default).
Reserved: "confirm before you speak" (refused in v1).

description:
READY `call_keys` (S50 §9.4): the trust anchors and client parameters. Absent when voice is
disabled.

crl.description: Serials of revoked, unexpired device certificates (at most 5,000).

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

crl_partial.description: More revoked serials exist: page them with `GET /api/v1/devices/crl`.

ds_public_key.description: The raw 32-byte DS Ed25519 key, for pinning.

title: ReadyCallKeys
